description: This file defines the RtlSupportDialog class, a GUI dialog for configuring right-to-left support options in an Android project, including checkboxes for manifest updates, layout modifications, and version-specific resources.

classes.name: RtlSupportDialog
classes.description: A dialog window for enabling and configuring RTL support features in an Android project.

methods.name: RtlSupportDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with project context, setting default values, and adding item listeners.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default checkbox selections for manifest and layout options.

methods.name: createActions
methods.description: Creates and returns the dialog's action buttons (OK, Cancel, Help).

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Returns the main panel component of the dialog.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component that should receive focus when the dialog opens.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Gathers and returns the current configuration options as an RtlSupportProperties object.
